description: Interactive web browser automation using Playwright MCP: navigating URLs, clicking elements, reading accessibility DOM snapshots, taking visual screenshots, and managing tabs.
routing_rules: Assign when a task requires rendering modern JavaScript websites, logging into web dashboards, or visual UI verification.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigates to a target URL in the browser and waits for the page to load.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Captures the structural accessibility DOM snapshot of the current page with interactive element references.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Clicks an interactive button, link, or element on the current page.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Enters text into a form input, textarea, or contenteditable element.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scrolls the browser viewport in the specified direction.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Waits for dynamic text to appear or disappear, or pauses for a specified duration.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Captures a visual screenshot of the current page and stores it in the artifacts directory.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: Manages browser tabs: list, create new, close, or select active tab.

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Navigates back to the previous page in browser history.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Closes the current page or active browser session.
